about_short_description.short_description: Simplex offers industrial solutions to a wide variety of regional manufacturers spanning a number of industries.

product.name: Router 130*250
product.description: A CNC router machine for cutting, engraving, and carving on various non-metallic materials like wood, acrylic, and plastics.

product.name: Multi-Head Router
product.description: A CNC router with multiple spindles for simultaneous machining to increase productivity in woodworking and furniture manufacturing.

product.name: Boring Router (Router for Drilling)
product.description: A CNC router specialized for drilling hinge holes, screw holes, and other precise boring tasks in furniture manufacturing.

product.name: Marble Router
product.description: A CNC router for engraving and carving on marble, stone, and glass materials used in decorative and architectural applications.

product.name: Plasma Cutting Machine 150*300
product.description: A plasma cutting machine for cutting and shaping various metals including iron, copper, stainless steel, and aluminum.

product.name: Metal Welding Machine
product.description: A welding machine for joining metals including stainless steel, iron, aluminum, and copper, used in advertising and metal fabrication.
